Select canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, and standard_units for all activity rows in assay CHEMBL1614161. Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, join compound_structures on molregno as an inner join, and join assays on assay_id. Filter by assays.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1614161' and activities.standard_relation = '=' and activities.standard_value IS NOT NULL. Keep every qualifying activity row without deduplication. Sort by canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, and standard_units.
